title: NEW 4BR | Rooftop • Firepit • Grill | 1.6mi 2Broad
description:
Kick back on the private rooftop—grill dinner, catch a game on the outdoor TV, or relax by the fire pit under string lights and skyline mural views. This brand new home sleeps 10, with comfy beds, stylish design, and plenty of space to gather. Enjoy free off-street parking for 3 cars, a fully stocked kitchen, and a prime location just 1.6 miles from Broadway. Perfect for group trips, celebrations, or anyone looking to call Nashville home for the weekend (or longer!)

The space
KEY FEATURES:
★ Perfect for Bachelor/Bachelorette trips, birthday getaways, or family vacations!
★ Private rooftop deck with fire pit, grill, TV, turf, mural, dining space, and lounge seating
★ Just 1.6 miles to Broadway, with easy access to 12 South, Music Row & The Gulch
★ Sleeps 10: 4 bedrooms with 1 King, 2 Queens, and 4 Twin beds (2 bunks)
★ 3 full bathrooms
★ Bold, photo-worthy design and mural art
★ Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances & bar cart
★ Free off-street parking for 3 cars (additional free street parking available)

HOME LAYOUT
1ST FLOOR
★ Private parking for 3 vehicles behind the home
★ Open concept kitchen + living area
★ Fully stocked kitchen w/ stainless steel appliances, coffee options, cookware, and barware
★ Living room with retractable ceiling mount TV and group seating
★ Bedroom 1: 1 Queen Bed + Ensuite Bathroom ( Shower/Tub Combo)

2ND FLOOR
★ Bedroom 2: 1 King Bed
★ Bedroom 3: 1 Queen Bed (Jack & Jill bathroom - Shower/Tub combo) - shared with Bedroom 2
★ Bedroom 4: Bunk Room with 2 Twin-over-Twin bunk beds (4 Twin total) + Ensuite Bathroom (Walk-in shower)

3RD FLOOR – THE ROOFTOP
★ Private rooftop oasis
★ Outdoor TV for game nights or movie marathons
★ Fire pit with cozy lounge seating
★ Dining table for group meals under string lights
★ Gas grill for cookouts
★ Astro-turf lawn for relaxing- no shoes, no problem!
★ Custom mural of the Nashville skyline—perfect for photo ops!

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire home, including all indoor and outdoor spaces. Enjoy the private rooftop deck with grill, fire pit, TV, and dining area—perfect for relaxing or entertaining. You'll also have free off-street parking for up to 3 vehicles. Check yourself in easily with a smart lock—no keys needed.

There are multiple Smart TVs in each room of the home, feel free to log in to your favorite streaming platform.

Other things to note
We are equipped with 24/7, motion-activated Ring cameras that capture audio and video, exclusively monitoring the exterior entries to ensure your safety while respecting your privacy indoors.
